question: Under explicitly illustrative independent normal measurements, how do detection-label mismatch, sign agreement and interval precision differ when synthetic truth and known standard errors change?
decision: Demonstrate and numerically verify statistical behavior that prevents interpreting unequal detection labels as biological assay discordance; do not fit or explain NAM outcomes.
strongest_rival: Conflating a detection cutoff with estimate precision, sign disagreement or a genuine difference in underlying biological effects.
discriminator: Five fixed synthetic scenarios, separate sign/detection/interval endpoints, and independently calculated normal-CDF probabilities with prespecified Monte Carlo tolerance.
exposure_record: Original paper and completed repository outcomes, including N. brasiliensis-history/later-IAV context, are exposed. These mathematical scenarios are newly authored illustrative assumptions, not empirically calibrated or unexposed biological validation.
biological_unit: Not applicable: independent computational draws from a fixed illustrative normal model, not biological samples.
nesting_and_overlap: Two independent estimates per draw in five separate seeded scenarios. Independence and common dimensionless effects are synthetic assumptions only; real RNA and ATAC scales are not equated.
population_and_selection: All five fixed scenarios with 200000 draws each and SeedSequence(20261030).spawn(5); no result-dependent scenario selection.
contrast: Known null/equal/opposite synthetic effects under equal or unequal known standard errors; no biological comparison.
endpoint: Detection-label mismatch, each detection status, sign agreement/opposition, interval coverage, sample mean and fixed 95-percent interval width.
methods: Generate independent normal estimates using numpy with prespecified seed; two-sided alpha .05 detection uses scipy ndtri. Verify probabilities using statistics.NormalDist CDF formulas independent of random draws; known-SE widths and means checked separately.
missingness_and_exclusions: No filtering or exclusion of draws/scenarios. Invalid assumptions or any failed analytic check stops execution while preserving outputs.
multiplicity: Eleven event checks plus mean/width checks per scenario, all retained. Pointwise alpha .05 is a simulated detection rule, not a multiple-testing decision about biological features.
precision_basis: Prespecified event tolerance 6*sqrt(p*(1-p)/200000)+2/200000; mean tolerance six known standard errors. This is Monte Carlo accuracy, not biological power or an effect margin.
interpretation_limit: No real source counts, biological margin, equivalence claim, NAM-mechanism explanation, intervention ranking or infection-response model. Known fixed SEs imply fixed interval widths within each scenario; a nonsignificant result can still be precise.
stop_rule: Stop on invalid parameters, hash mismatch or any prespecified analytic tolerance failure. Retain every scenario and failure; never tune assumptions or tolerance to rescue a result.
amendment_reason: New owner-authorized synthetic measurement extension E3; does not amend or repeat original NAM or external biological analyses.
